item.name: light-leak-tabs
item.summary: navigation: ARIA tabs over a furnace slot: the selected tab lets the firelight through and the light slides as you switch (canvas 2D, server-safe tabs)

useWhen: Three to five sections of related content in one card (features, plans, steps)
A product or brand page where the tabs are a focal element
avoidWhen: More than about six tabs, or tabs that must wrap onto two rows

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The tabs alone with a plain underline on the selected tab; no canvas, no sliding light.

input.pointer: Click a tab to select it; the light slides after it
input.keyboard: Roving tabindex: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (wrapping), Home and End move and select; Tab moves into the panel

a11y.notes: WAI-ARIA tabs: a named tablist of native buttons with role=tab, aria-selected and aria-controls, one tabpanel labelled by the selected tab and focusable. The light canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: tabs
props.type: { id: string; label: React.ReactNode; content: React.ReactNode }[]

props.name: label
props.effect: Required. Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: defaultValue
props.effect: Initial tab id when uncontrolled (the first tab if omitted).

props.name: onValueChange
props.effect: Called with the newly selected tab id.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Keep tabs to a handful of short labels: they share one row.
Give every tab a stable, unique id; the selection is tracked by id.
label is required: it names the tab list for screen readers.
verify: Server HTML has a tablist with one selected tab and its panel.
ArrowRight, ArrowLeft, Home and End move the selection and focus.
The light slides to the new tab and then the loop stops.
